mechanism: Buprenorphine may induce CYP3A4 metabolism of medroxyprogesterone, potentially reducing contraceptive efficacy, while medroxyprogesterone may inhibit buprenorphine metabolism through CYP3A4, increasing opioid exposure.
action: Monitor for reduced contraceptive efficacy and consider alternative contraception; counsel on potential opioid side effects and assess for breakthrough pain or withdrawal symptoms.
